subject: SIG kickoff + evidence roadmap for FinOptics (post-demo items)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@finoptics.com>, Anil Kumar <anil.kumar@finoptics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-06T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: SIG kickoff + evidence roadmap for FinOptics (post-demo items)

Hi Marta / Anil — great to meet you on the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the vendor questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ) kicked off and to surface any SOC 2 / HIPAA dependencies up front.

Recap from our call:
- Scope: Redwood to provide hosted inference for FinOptics fraud-detection feature (production + dev sandboxes).
- Primary compliance concerns: SOC 2 Type II evidence, HIPAA applicability for PHI extraction in a subset of flows, and EU/US data residency for a pilot (US first).
- You mentioned a preference for a prefilled CAIQ to accelerate review.

Our proposed next steps:
1) We can prefill the CAIQ worksheet and share the prefill for your reviewers to validate (Redwood owner: Karthik).
2) We’ll attach our SOC 2 overview and a simplified data flow diagram to illustrate custody and where PHI may touch the platform (see attachments).
3) Please confirm whether you need a BAA/HIPAA addendum signed — that will determine additional evidence (audit logs, access reviews).
4) Assign a primary technical reviewer at FinOptics (who will triage evidence requests).

Clarifying questions from our side to help scope the SIG and evidence roadmap:
- Data residency: will the initial pilot be US-only or do you require EU processing for any flows?
- PHI surface area: can you share a short list of the specific attributes you consider PHI for this use case?
- Evidence cadence: do you need the full SOC 2 Type II report or is the SOC 2 description + security controls mapping sufficient for your procurement team initially?
- Preferred questionnaire format: CAIQ XLSX (we can prefill), SIG Lite (shorter), or your custom vendor intake form?

Proposed timeline: Redwood to upload CAIQ prefill + SOC 2 overview within 5 business days after confirmation of format and reviewer. Evidence handoff and clarifying Qs the week following.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_soc2_overview.pdf (PDF, 320KB)], [Attachment: redwood_data_flow_diagram.png (PNG, 180KB)]

Thanks — happy to jump on a short follow-up call if that helps move things faster.

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear recap, Jordan — and thanks for the demo team. A few quick notes from FinOptics: 

- We would prefer you prefill the CAIQ XLSX; that speeds up our internal review cycles.
- We do require a HIPAA addendum (BAA) for any vendors that might process PHI. Please confirm whether Redwood is willing to sign our standard BAA (we can share a redline).
- For procurement, we will ultimately need a SOC 2 Type II report. For initial gating, a SOC 2 controls mapping + SOC 2 status (Type II in the last 12 months or in-progress) is okay.

Also: our security reviewer will want a short write-up on key management and encryption in transit/at-rest — can you include those sections in the CAIQ prefill or as supplemental evidence?

Primary technical reviewer for this engagement will be Anil Kumar (cc’d). Our target timeline: initial prefill + evidence pack within 10 business days; procurement needs to start the vendor review ASAP.

Regards,
Marta Ruiz
Chief Information Security Officer | FinOptics

Thanks, Marta — this is helpful. Confirming the plan and owners below: 

- Format: CAIQ XLSX prefill (Redwood action: Karthik to own prefill). We will mark any items that need legal/engineering input.
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood accepts discussing a BAA; can we get your standard template to review? Camila (cc’d) will coordinate legal on our side.
- SOC 2: we will include SOC 2 status, an executive summary, and the controls mapping in the prefill package. If you need the full Type II report we can provide it under an NDA or via a secure link.

A couple of quick follow-ups for scoping the evidence requests: 
1) Data residency: for the pilot you mentioned US-only — confirm if any EU tenant is expected during the pilot window.
2) Access: please confirm whether FinOptics requires dedicated accounts/isolated tenancy (Redwood Dedicated) or if host/prod shared tenancy is acceptable for the initial phase. This affects which evidence buckets we collect.

I’ve started a CAIQ prefill sheet (attached) and will push a first pass by EOD next Tuesday (2026-06-09). Camila will coordinate legal review on the BAA.

Jordan — quick update from our side after syncing with procurement/legal: 

- We prefer the CAIQ prefill approach + a short HIPAA addendum. Procurement will circulate our vendor intake form (attached) that lists required evidence (SOC 2, encryption details, key management, penetration test summary).
- Our internal reviewers: Anil (technical) and our legal counsel will review the BAA. Expect a 2-week window for our first-pass review once we receive the prefill.
- Regarding the SOC 2 report: procurement expects a Type II report — initially a controls mapping and summary will suffice while we queue the full report under NDA.

Please include explicit fields in the prefill for: encryption at-rest algorithm and key management provider, access control model, and where logs/audit trails are stored.

Attaching our intake form: [Attachment: FinOptics_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]. Once we receive the prefill I’ll confirm the exact legal contact for the BAA redline.
